title: Compyla font lockfile
description: compyla.lock: pins each font family and style a project's templates use to the bytes that render them (architecture.md D14; markdown-spec.md §3, §10.3, C62). `compyla fonts sync` writes it; the CLI's font resolver reads it and returns the cached file named by each entry's SHA-256. Entries are sorted by family, compared without ASCII case, then by style in the order regular, bold, italic, boldItalic, and a family and style appear at most once.

family.description: The family as the template names it.

source.description: Where `fonts sync` found the bytes: a user-supplied file, or Google Fonts. Fonts embedded in a template are read from the template itself (§3), so they aren't pinned here.

from.description: The file path or URL the bytes came from, for people. The resolver reads only the digest.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the font file's bytes, in lower-case hex, which names the file in the cache.
